additionalPests.name: Bolting
additionalPests.signs: Flower stems rise; leaf production declines.
additionalPests.control: Remove early flower stems; replace plants once flowering persists.

additionalPests.name: Downy mildew
additionalPests.signs: Yellow patches above; grey-purple mould below.
additionalPests.control: Remove diseased leaves; thin promptly and improve drainage.
